description: Build a rich, on-brand landing page from an ordered list of typed blocks, publish it, and return its live URL + its own QR code (`qr_id`; style it with the QR design args here, restyle later with update_qr_code — don't create another). This is the 'make me a page for X' tool — e.g. an event, product, restaurant, link-in-bio, or a scan-to-enter sweepstakes. Each block is {type, content}; call list_block_types first to see every type and its content shape. Blocks render in order in a centered column; a 'header' block (name/bio/photo) is the profile.

background_color.description: For the QR code this mints: Hex background color, or 'transparent'.

blocks.description: Ordered page blocks. Each is {type, content}. See list_block_types.

content.description: The block's content, matching that type's schema.

form.description: For a 'form' block: the form id to embed.

full_width.description: image/gallery/video/embed only: stretch to the screen edges.

hidden.description: Hide this block from the live page.

type.description: Block type, e.g. header, link, text, video, faq, countdown.

visible_from.description: Optional ISO date-time the block starts showing, e.g. 2030-05-01T09:00:00Z.

visible_until.description: Optional ISO date-time the block stops showing.

color_scope.description: For the QR code this mints: 'whole' (default) or 'pattern_only', as in create_qr_code.

domain.description: Custom domain (else a default is used).

error_correction.description: For the QR code this mints: QR error correction level (L, M, Q, H). Leave unset: it is chosen automatically (H with a logo, Q otherwise).

eye_color.description: For the QR code this mints: Hex color for the corner eyes, only if different from `primary_color`.

eye_style.description: For the QR code this mints: Corner eye shape.

frame.description: For the QR code this mints: Frame slug, as in create_qr_code. Set `text` without a `frame` and one that can show it is chosen automatically.

frame_color.description: For the QR code this mints: Hex color for the frame, only if different from `primary_color`.

has_border.description: For the QR code this mints: Draw a border around the code.

logo_url.description: For the QR code this mints: URL of a logo image to place in the center.

pattern.description: For the QR code this mints: Module pattern style.

primary_color.description: For the QR code this mints: Hex color for the QR pattern, e.g. #111111. Eyes and frame follow it automatically (rules as in create_qr_code).

publish.description: Publish immediately (default true). false leaves it a draft.

text.description: For the QR code this mints: Caption text; a frame that can show it is chosen automatically.

text_secondary.description: For the QR code this mints: Secondary caption line, where the frame supports it.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Optional when the account has one workspace; use list_workspaces to resolve otherwise.

name: build_page

blocks.description: Number of blocks on the page.

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (isError): cause, retryable, message.
